body: Founder approved the restart. Fixed XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1000 (same known issue as the redgarden permission-denied fix -- this shell inherits root's runtime dir) to actually reach the user systemd bus, copied gta7-0.1.0.jar into server/plugins/, systemctl --user restart einhorn-survival.service. Server log confirms clean load: '[GTA7] Enabling GTA7 v0.1.0' -> '[GTA7] GTA7 enabled -- VS0/VS1/VS2/VS3/VS4 + IDUNA integration + chat bridge live.' with no exceptions. /sudoku is live for any connected player.
title: GTA7 /sudoku deployed live to EINHORN_SURVIVAL
